{{Short description|Mathematician}}
[[File:Xavier Fernique.jpg|thumb|220px|Fernique in 1975]]
'''Xavier Fernique''' (3 May 1934  – 15 March 2020) was a [[mathematician]], noted mostly for his contributions to the theory of [[stochastic processes]].  [[Fernique's theorem]], a result on the [[Integrable system|integrability]] of [[Gaussian measure]]s, is named after him.
